This is a single-case clinical report (N=1) of childhood-onset cerebellar ataxia due to a homozygous SQSTM1 mutation and is not about behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD). It does not use the required imaging modalities (only routine MRI reported, not VBM, fMRI, or FDG-PET), includes only one patient (fewer than the required ≥6), reports no between-group contrasts in standardized (MNI/Talairach) space comparing a bvFTD group to controls, and provides no whole-brain voxelwise results. Therefore it does not meet the meta-analysis inclusion criteria.

The study used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and included clinically diagnosed bvFTD cases with sufficient group sizes, and reported whole-brain VBM results. However, the FTD patients were analyzed as a pooled FTD group (bvFTD + semantic dementia) and the paper does not report any between-group, whole-brain voxelwise contrast or coordinate results specifically for a bvFTD-only group (i.e., bvFTD vs controls in MNI/Talairach). Therefore it fails critical inclusion criteria I6 and I7 requiring bvFTD-specific whole-brain contrasts. No exclusion criteria from the list apply.

The study uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) and reports whole-brain, voxelwise group comparisons (patients vs. controls). The SOC/EXEC subgroup is explicitly described as nonaphasic patients with disorders of social comportment and executive processing—corresponding to the behavioral/frontal variant of FTD (bvFTD) used by the review. Sample sizes meet minimums (SOC/EXEC n=32; imaging controls n=12; cognitive controls n=29). The paper reports group-level whole-brain atrophy results for each patient subgroup (including SOC/EXEC) in stereotactic space with coordinates transformed (MNI→Talairach) and uses voxelwise thresholds; correlations and contrasts are reported. No exclusion criteria are met: this is an original, empirical VBM study (not an ROI-only analysis, review, or other excluded design), and participants with other dementias or major psychiatric/medical comorbidities were excluded at recruitment. Full text contains introduction, methods, results, and discussion (complete). Therefore the study satisfies inclusion criteria I3, I4, I5, I6, I7, I8 and is appropriate for inclusion in the bvFTD meta-analysis.

The full text reports whole-brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analyses in MNI space, includes a clearly identified behavioural-variant FTD subgroup (bvFTD; n=11) and healthy controls (n=15), and presents group-level voxelwise results (t-tests and clusters/coordinates reported/overlaid on MNI brain, with supplementary figures/tables). Imaging modality = VBM, bvFTD sample size and control sample size both exceed 6. Between-group contrasts and whole-brain voxelwise results specific to bvFTD versus controls are described (patterns of atrophy and voxelwise correlations), and coordinates/cluster maxima are provided. The full text includes Introduction, Methods, Results and Discussion; supplementary material referenced for figures/tables. Therefore all inclusion criteria I3,I4,I5,I6,I7,I8 are met and no exclusion criteria apply.

This is an empirical VBM study that includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD group (n=16) and healthy controls (n=18). VBM was performed with normalization to MNI space and whole-brain, voxelwise group contrasts are reported (controls>FTD, FTD>PSP) and voxelwise correlations; results include whole-brain FWE-corrected findings and exploratory uncorrected maps, with anatomical coordinates/regions described. Sample sizes exceed the ≥6 threshold. No exclusion criteria are met (not a review, not ROI-only, not limited to non-eligible modalities, and participants with concurrent psychiatric/other dementias were excluded). Full text (intro, methods, results, discussion, conclusion) is provided. Thus all required inclusion criteria (I3,I4,I5,I6,I7,I8) are satisfied and the study should be included.

Although this paper uses VBM (I3), includes clinically diagnosed FTD patients (behavioral-variant FTD/FTD subgroup, I4) and has adequate sample sizes (I5), it does not report a between-group, whole-brain (voxelwise) contrast specifically isolating the bvFTD (behavioral variant FTD) group versus controls. VBM results are reported for FTLD as a pooled group (FTD + semantic dementia) rather than for bvFTD alone, and no group-level, whole-brain coordinates/contrast are provided that are unambiguously from an isolated bvFTD group. Therefore inclusion criteria I6 and I7 are not satisfied. No exclusion criteria from the list (E5–E9) are met. Full text appears complete. Excluded for failing to provide bvFTD-specific whole-brain between-group results (I6, I7 not met).

This study uses whole-brain VBM and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD patients (16 bvFTD) with adequate group sizes and reports voxelwise, whole-brain contrasts. However, the published group-level VBM results are reported for an aggregated FTSD group (which pools bvFTD and PPA cases) rather than for a bvFTD-only contrast. Inclusion criterion I6 requires a between-group contrast comparing a bvFTD group (not pooled with other patient groups/variants) to controls; this specific bvFTD-only, whole-brain voxelwise contrast is not provided. Therefore the study does not meet the requirement that at least one group-level, whole-brain result clearly derives from the target bvFTD sample. No exclusion criteria (E5–E9) are triggered, and the full text appears complete.

This study meets the review objective and all required inclusion criteria. It uses FDG-PET imaging (I3). The sample comprises 29 clinically diagnosed frontotemporal dementia patients selected with standard clinical criteria and excludes PPA and semantic dementia, corresponding to the behavioral variant FTD phenotype (I4). Sample sizes exceed thresholds (29 patients; controls per center >=6) (I5). The paper reports between-group voxelwise contrasts and SPM results in MNI space (coordinates reported: 4,62,-6) comparing the FTD group to controls (I6). Whole-brain, group-level voxelwise analyses (SPM conjunction analyses and thresholding) are clearly reported (I7), with results described in text and coordinates (I8). No exclusion criteria apply: it is an empirical FDG-PET study with whole-brain analyses, not an ROI-only paper or review, and there is no indication of major psychiatric comorbidity or pooling with other patient groups. Full text contains introduction, methods, results, and discussion and appears complete.

While the full text reports whole-brain VBM analyses and includes a clinically diagnosed bvFTD subgroup (n=20) with adequate control sample (n=13), the imaging results are reported as voxelwise correlations of sarcasm performance across a pooled, multi-diagnostic cohort and co-atrophy/diagnostic-covariate checks. The paper does not present a whole-brain, group-level between-group voxelwise contrast directly comparing the bvFTD group to healthy controls (in MNI/Talairach space) where bvFTD is not pooled with other patient groups. Therefore inclusion criteria I3, I4, and I5 are met, but I6 and I7 are not met. No exclusion criteria from the review are triggered.

This study meets all required inclusion criteria: it uses voxel-based morphometry (VBM) (I3); participants were clinically diagnosed with behavioral variant FTD (bvFTD) (I4); patient group size (n=17) and matched control group (n≈17) exceed the minimum of 6 (I5); results report between-group VBM contrasts in MNI space comparing the bvFTD group to controls (I6); whole-brain, voxelwise group-level results are presented and described (I7); and reported whole-brain results are clearly described in the text/figures (I8). No exclusion criteria are met: the paper is an empirical VBM study (not a review), reports whole-brain analyses (not ROI-only), and does not rely solely on excluded modalities. Full text appears complete (includes Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion).

The study includes resting-state fMRI (I3) and includes clinically diagnosed bvFTD participants (I4). However, the bvFTD cases (N=4) are part of a pooled FTD group (N=10) and the analyses/reporting do not present bvFTD-specific, between-group whole-brain (voxelwise) contrasts versus controls. The review requires (a) at least 6 patients in the target patient group (bvFTD) (I5), (b) bvFTD-specific between-group voxelwise results not pooled with other subtypes (I6), and (c) at least one group-level whole-brain result clearly identified as coming from the target sample (I7). These criteria are not met. No exclusion criteria apply. Full text appears complete.

This study meets the meta-analysis requirements for inclusion. It used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) as the imaging modality, reporting whole-brain, voxelwise contrasts (warped into MNI space) relating patient subgroups to controls with peak loci summarized in Table 4. The SOC/EXEC (social/executive) subgroup corresponds to the behavioral/ social variant of FTLD (bvFTD-like clinical presentation: loss of insight, social disinhibition, apathy, and executive dysfunction) and was defined by consensus clinical criteria; the SOC/EXEC group had N=12 overall and N=9 with MRI, satisfying the sample-size requirement. The paper presents group-level whole-brain VBM results specifically for this subgroup (Panel C, Table 4) rather than pooling bvFTD-like cases with other patient groups. No exclusion criteria (e.g., ROI-only analyses, non-empirical paper, incompatible imaging modality, comorbid psychiatric disorders) are met based on the full text. Therefore the study is eligible for inclusion as a VBM whole-brain study of a bvFTD-equivalent patient group.

This document is a grant report summarizing multiple projects (non-empirical summary) rather than a single original empirical study presenting new coordinate-based whole-brain voxelwise results. Exclusion criteria: E8 (non-empirical paper without original data) applies. Inclusion criteria: I3 is satisfied in that the report describes FDG-PET and structural MRI work. However, inclusion criteria I4 (explicit sample of clinically diagnosed bvFTD/Pick’s with counts), I5 (sample sizes ≥6 reported for bvFTD group and controls), I6 (at least one between-group contrast reported in MNI/Talairach space comparing bvFTD to controls without pooling), and I7 (at least one group-level whole-brain voxelwise result from the target bvFTD sample) are not met in the report. Therefore the study must be excluded.
